prompt: awk next statement executed END action historical behavior
answer:
Historically, `awk` implementations behaved as follows when `next` was executed in special actions:

- In a `BEGIN` action: they produced an error.
- In an `END` action: they terminated `awk`.

This behavior was undocumented and was not standardized. POSIX therefore specifies that behavior as undefined in either a `BEGIN` or `END` action. GNU `awk` treats `next` there as a syntax error. In ordinary record-processing actions, `next` abandons the current record; if that reaches end-of-input, `END` actions are executed.

Source: [POSIX awk rationale](https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/utilities/awk.html#tag_20_06_13_10); [GNU awk manual](https://www.gnu.org/software/gawk/manual/html_node/Next-Statement.html).
